pages.text: An Extra Skill for practitioners who specialize in talisman creation. It opens the talisman-making interface.

$(bold)Type:$() Extra Skill$(br)$(bold)Input:$() Press the skill key$(br)$(bold)Cost:$() None$(br2)Using the skill opens the Talisman Table interface and plays a page-turn sound. It does not use a toggle state; it is a direct activation skill.
